user.title: Your address in Utrecht
user.description: Fill in your postcode and house number. Works for the whole municipality of Utrecht (including Leidsche Rijn, Vleuten and De Meern).

data_description.addition: Letter or number after the house number, e.g. A

choose.title: Which address?
choose.description: There are several addresses at this house number.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Afvalwijzer. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.address_not_found: No address found. Is this postcode in the municipality of Utrecht?
error.addition_not_found: This addition does not exist at this house number. Leave it empty to choose from a list.

data.reminder_targets: Send a reminder the evening before to

data_description.reminder_targets: Tick your phone (needs the Home Assistant Companion app). Nothing ticked = no reminder. You never get a reminder on the pickup day itself.
data_description.reminder_time: On the evening before a pickup day, e.g. 18:00.
data_description.text_language: Used in Today, Tomorrow, Notice, the calendar and the reminder.
data_description.update_hours: The municipality sometimes moves pickup days (holidays, new routes). 6 hours is fine; lower only if you want changes sooner.
